followups.note: This is a review of cell-line models of pancreatic cancer and does not measure Kras-driven PanIN formation in adult mouse acinar cells.
The experiments use human pancreatic duct cells transfected with K-ras(G12V) and measure ROS and capsaicin toxicity, not PanIN induction in adult mouse acinar cells.
Mutant K-ras is expressed in K19-positive gastric epithelial cells and the reported outcome is gastric dysplasia, not pancreatic mPanIN.
The study examines Notch and NF-kB signaling in compound K-ras(G12D) and Ink4a/Arf-deficient mice that develop PDAC, rather than testing adult acinar-restricted Kras alone.
The paper studies Sin3B and oncogene-induced senescence in fibroblasts and does not test pancreatic acinar Kras.
Oncogenic K-Ras is tested in adult Pdx1-expressing and insulin-expressing pancreatic cells, not in Elastase- or Mist1-positive mature acinar cells.
This is a human tissue survey of KRAS mutations in acinar cells, ADM, and PanIN, not an experimental activation of Kras in adult mouse acinar cells.
Mutant Kras in the mouse exocrine pancreas is studied with pancreatitis and beta-catenin, and the abstract does not report adult Elastase- or Mist1-restricted activation.
Mist1-driven Kras(G12D) is activated in gastric chief cells and produces gastric metaplasia, not pancreatic mPanIN.
Conditional Kras activation in mature mouse acinar cells induced PanIN lesions comparable to those from ubiquitous Kras activation.
The experiment traces p53-null clones inside already Kras-initiated pancreatic and lung tumors rather than testing adult acinar Kras as the cause of PanIN.
P48-Cre activates KrasG12D from pancreatic progenitors together with Fbxw7 deletion, which is not adult acinar-restricted Elastase or Mist1 targeting.
The study is about XBP1 and Mist1 in gastric zymogenic-cell maturation and does not activate pancreatic Kras.

Oncogenic K-ras is linked to SAHA resistance in fibroblasts, colon tumors, and lung cancer cells, not to pancreatic acinar PanIN.
Notch2 is deleted in a KrasG12D-driven pancreatic cancer model to study PanIN progression, not whether adult acinar Kras initiates mPanIN.
